tasks.title: Handle empty input in average
tasks.goal: Fix average so an empty input returns no value. Preserve its behavior for nonempty numeric input.

tasks.title: Fix percentile boundary handling
tasks.goal: Fix percentile so the inclusive lower and upper probability bounds return the minimum and maximum values. Preserve ordering and existing intermediate percentile behavior.

tasks.title: Add median
tasks.goal: Add a public median function supporting odd and even input lengths. Return no value for empty input and do not mutate the caller's values.

tasks.title: Add stable filter_above
tasks.goal: Add a public filter_above function that returns values strictly greater than the threshold, in their original order, without mutating the caller's input.

tasks.title: Document the public metrics API
tasks.goal: Update README.md with a concise reference for the public average, percentile, summary, median, and filter_above functions, including their empty-input behavior.

tasks.title: Add boundary examples
tasks.goal: Add runnable or unambiguous README examples for empty input, the p=0 and p=100 percentile bounds, and both odd and even medians.

tasks.title: Extract shared numeric validation
tasks.goal: Refactor the numeric input checks used by average and percentile into one private reusable helper. Keep public behavior and error handling unchanged.

tasks.title: Extract summary aggregation
tasks.goal: Refactor summary aggregation into a private reusable helper and keep the public summary result and edge-case behavior unchanged.
